lead_headline: Foreclosures remain cold below $4M threshold while subscriptions flat-line—restaurant tracker adds zero leads on Sunday dormancy

restaurant.blurb: Zero leads detected Sunday—weekend data drought expected. Friday's batch flagged Tavern on Blake (Five Points), Läderach chocolate (Cherry Creek), Miya Moon (Baker). Active: 237 leads.

liquor.blurb: Seventh consecutive zero-application day extends unprecedented dormancy into third week. 7-day window remains frozen at 369 licenses—all submitted June 14 during mass database clearance following two-week system shutdown. No new filings, status updates, or removals detected since Saturday's processing event. Current void now surpasses all prior records as June's 25-day count holds at 369 applications versus typical monthly baseline of 800+. Post-backlog silence suggests systemic change rather than seasonal dip.

reputation.blurb: Single mention Saturday—weekend slump drops 7-day total to 53 mentions across 14 sources, up 8% from prior week despite Saturday collapse. Denver Post contributed 19 citations (36% of volume), covering Broomfield satellite plant, RiNo lease disputes, water fee surge. Facebook delivered 8 mentions, Instagram 5, Reddit 4. Week's uneven cadence—strong Monday-Wednesday, Thursday-Saturday void—mirrors June's volatility as monthly total (193) tracks toward 250-citation finish. Google News RSS captured 52 of 53 discoveries; Reddit RSS contributed one.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +0 yesterday (0 new, 0 canceled) extends Saturday dormancy, holding MTD at +25 (+1.2/day) while 90-day net stays at +131. Weekend freeze follows Friday's single addition that broke prior five-day void. Current week's +9 net (17 new, 8 canceled) lags last period's +7 through comparable Sunday, though lower churn (8 vs 13 cancellations) offsets acquisition gap. Recent two-week pattern shows clustering—Jun 11-18 burst delivered +16 net before collapse—but weekend's zero-activity pause keeps MTD velocity (+1.2) aligned with YTD baseline (+1.3) as June's final third begins.
